notes.title: v2.0 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924855/daa6648e051365b3bdff63bfb32c89c08b916734.jpg[/img]

Mana Cycle Version v2.0.0 has finally been released! The major changes are as follows: 

[list]
[*] - FOUR new playable characters: Erif, Bithecary, Better You, and Xuirbo! These characters introduce a lot of new mechanics into the game with their complex abilities. Make sure to check them out!
[*] - FULL JAPANESE LOCALIZATION has been added to the game. This includes Story Mode and Gauntlet Mode, which were previously not localized.
[*] - New ACHIEVEMENTS have been added based on the new playable characters!
[*]  - The game's rotation system has been internally reworked in order to accommodate the new character abilities. This will not affect any strategies but will help implement future characters.
[*] - Various other minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

Check out this trailer showcasing the new characters!
[previewyoutube=9Snw5OMmqEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy Cycling, everyone! :)

notes.title: v1.2.7 Update!
notes.content:
Mana Cycle Version 1.2.7 has been released! The major changes are as follows: 

[list]
[*] Two new playable characters, Electro and Romra! Each characters have new unique abilities, so have fun experimenting with them!
[*] New backgrounds have been added to the battle scene for visual variety. They can still be disabled with the "Simple BG" option in the settings.
[*] Some non-functional steam achievements have been fixed, and some new ones have been added!
[*] The main menu and character select scenes have been refurbished to look nicer.
[*] Various other bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

Happy Cycling, everyone! :]

notes.title: v1.2.6 Update
notes.content:
Mana Cycle Version 1.2.6 has been released. The changes are as follows: 

[list]
[*] Implemented a Simple Background toggle in the settings. The current background can now be toggled for a solid color one for performance and visual clarity.
[*] Fixed Multi-Device input mode disconnecting both devices at the beginning of the match.
[*] Fixed Dual-Keyboard input mode causing a softlock in the Solo Menu.
[*] Fixed Aqua's active ability sending regular mana instead of trash mana.
[*] Fixed a typo.
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with us. Happy Cycling! :]

notes.title: v1.2.5 Update
notes.content:
Mana Cycle Version 1.2.5 has been released. The changes are as follows: 

[list]
[*] Implemented particles effects when clearing Mana. The opacity of particles can be adjusted in the settings. 
[*] Fixed a bug in Gauntlet Mode where stats would show Starting Special in a range from 0-1% rather than 0-100%
[*] Fixed a bug in Gauntlet Mode where placeholder text would sometimes show in the inventory when the player had no items.
[*] Fixed visual artifacts on HP and Special Meters.
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with us. Happy Cycling! :]
